title: Magnitude 7+ Earthquakes Haven't Increased In Over 100 Years
hook: Magnitude 7+ earthquakes still average just 17 each year.
closing: More earthquake headlines reflect better detection, not a planet suddenly shaking harder.
question: Does that change the headlines?

segments.say: Earthquake stations reached 8,000, so modern instruments hear tremors earlier networks completely missed.
Magnitude 7+ earthquakes average 17 yearly, barely changing across a century of records.
Scientists now locate 20,000 earthquakes yearly, making improved detection look like worsening geology.
